question: What is the meaning of density in relation to material layers, materials?
description: Density is the mass per unit volume of a material. In the context of material layers and materials, it is essential for determining the weight of the materials present within the structure. This weight can subsequently aid in assessing the potential for reuse, among other applications. The density is also crucial for evaluating the environmental impacts of the materials, as it can affect the Global Warming Potential and other sustainability metrics.
